brief:
Several hundred protesters occupied a planned Microsoft data center construction site in Amsterdam on Friday to demonstrate against the technology company's alleged involvement in facilitating operations in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The activists disrupted work at the facility as part of their campaign against Microsoft's activities.

The occupation reflected growing pressure on tech companies over their operations and contracts related to the Israeli military and occupation of Palestinian territories. Demonstrators have increasingly targeted major technology firms they accuse of enabling surveillance and military capabilities used in Gaza.
